translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Ŋei Eŋe Yesu Pilat Wano Ma Arikoi
Kepe qaeki ruoropka, pris ŋetne korop so Yuda ŋei suaine, eŋe Yesu qeu seukeakane don aukoi.
Eŋe mulap togoleŋo Yesu metine wokomge more mau paki, Roma ware ware suaine Pilat wano ma ari birakakoi.
Yudas Eŋe Yesu Ware Ware Wano Ma Ariu Kaki Paki Ari Ebine Rapokke
Yudas, siron qeqe ŋei, eŋe ongi Yesu mo seukeakane ra togolekoi, yale kaki paki, wetne mainge more, wesi silwa 30 ea koso mazinge ari Pris ŋetne so Yuda ŋei suaine ebonge.
Paki rake, “Na sotkorop okanbe paki, ŋei sotine midaine iwa ma wakonka seuseuo birakamaile!” Eŋe mainge rakoi, “Ea ŋenano onoka wane sari ramaine? Eamo geŋone aboŋ!”
Yudas eŋe wesi yewa biraki, Bakom Urumgo wakiso biraone ketke. Ket ari moreso, oŋomka ebine rapokke.
Pris ŋetne eŋe wesi yewa mau paki rakoi, “Wesi iwa yemo weŋem kiti kitine, ea wane ŋene ŋenze ra rokop donze yewa qe barake more, Bakom Urum wane wesi kiteo mi biraŋem kesiake.”
Eŋe don auye, dereret okan naguwi paki, ea wane ŋadino wesi yewa mau paki, kap gola mama wane kepe mane ea qolekoi, eamo lobo ŋei abaran ŋine sari sarine, eŋane deŋesere mane okaniakane.
Ea wane eŋe kepe yewa eŋetne “Weŋem wane kepe” orakoi, wane naso iwao pamaike.
Yale okanbi, propet Yeremaiaŋo don mane iwa yale rake, ea wane wele wakonge, “Eŋe wesi silwa 30 ea makoi, Israel ŋei eŋe dereret okannagu more, wesi yewa ŋei ea qolekakei wane biŋek qekoi.
Paki wesi yewaŋo ma more, kap mama wane kepe mane qolekoi, eamo Waomŋo nolatke, ea wane rokopko.”
Pilatŋo Yesu Qesonkake
Yesu eŋe Pilat wane kaitko okoraki, oŋo qesonka rake, “Ge Yuda ŋei eŋane ŋei waom me?” Yesuŋo mainge rake, “Goŋom mo ea ramaine.”
Eŋe pris ŋetne so ŋei suaine edo gube qesat don solaine more rakoi, ea wane turuŋine mane mi mainge edange.
Eso ea wane Pilatŋo olale rake, “Ge don iwa korop solaŋone qeu paki ramami, ea mi detmaine me?”
Ŋo Yesuŋo don mide mane nigatne mi mainge olatke, eso ea wane Pilat eŋe zok manerop oŋaine qaeke.
Pilatŋo Yesu Kibego Qekei Wane Rakokke
Aŋeloŋo Loloŋonge Naso, yewao Pilat eŋe ŋei ŋerep magu edo rauso, mulap ŋei mane siwotkaki, mulap urumgo ŋine saket okanmaŋke.
Wane, naso yewao ŋei mane eŋetine Yesu Barabas, eŋe mulap urumgo metke.
Eso ea wane ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe sari lewageu, Pilatŋo qeson one rake, “Ŋine ma ŋei siwotka ŋibonikalane wetkemami? Yesu Barabas me Yesu, Mesia oramami?”
Pilat eŋe kine mo detlukke, onoka wane eŋe Yesu wane det worik okanbi paki, ma ari eŋane meto birakakoi.

Pilat eŋe wano wanok urumgoka metki, eŋine ŋanomineŋo don mane iwa yale motki arike, “Ge ŋei sotine midaine, ea kine kine mane misuk okankaikene, onoka wane na yatne ruoo kulu kulu kawe paki, eŋane ra more wikile zok suaine maratkele.”
Pris ŋetne so ŋei suaine eŋe ŋei ŋerep magu taleongoi, eŋe Pilat olatpi Barabas siwotka ebongi paki, Yesu birakaki qeu seukeakane.
Ŋo Pilatŋo yemo qeson one rake, “Ŋei etke iwa erano ŋine ŋei diawa siwotka ŋibonikalane wetkemami?” Eŋe rakoi, “Barabas!”
Rau Pilatŋo qesonone rake, “Pakimo na Yesu, Mesia oramami, eŋe daleo okankaikale!” Eŋe rakoi, “Eŋe kibego rasu kanom!”
Pilatŋo yemo qesonone rake, “Onoka sot okangane?” Pakiso eŋe togoleka boka rakoi, “Eŋe kibego rasu kanom!”

Pilat eŋe mo kake, eŋane don eaŋo mi rokoponge, kawali suaineka wakoniakane okange, ea wane eŋe doku natne ma more, ŋei ŋerep magu eŋane kaiteno metine saukki paki rake, “Ŋei iwa seukeake, yemo noŋo rawe mi seukeake! Iwa yemo ŋinane aboŋ!”
Ŋei ŋerep magu eŋe mainge rakoi, “Eŋane seuseuinane turuŋ yemo qeligenom, ŋene so doko ŋosakopze ŋenane kutzo pa wayake!”
Pakiso, Pilat eŋe Barabas siwotka ebonge, ŋo Yesu yemo kumunamŋo qeki paki, kawali ŋei eŋane meteeno birakake, kibego rasukaikei wane.
Kawali Ŋei Eŋe Yesu Isibela Qebela Okankakoi
Pilat wane kawali ŋei eŋe Yesu mau paki, ware ware wane urum koto ma waketkoi, pakiso kawali ŋei korop eŋe sari qeatkakoi.
Paki, eŋe eŋine takotine ea kito qoke more, takot weŋemka kiroine ea birakakoi.

Pakiso, eŋe sitman wakelerop, eaŋo ŋei waom marok mane mau paki, lewino birau ketkiso, kumunam mane metine wonino motkoi. Paki eŋe eŋane osino wawetene geu paki, isi bela qebela okankau paki rakoi. “Yuda ŋei eŋane Ŋei Waom, naso kiroroine ge ari arikene!”
Eŋe sopotkau paki, kumunam oma ka more, lewino rasipokkoi.
So eŋe isi bela qebela okankawareu qoeki, takot weŋemka kiroine ea kito qokkau paki, eŋine takotine ea koso mainge birakakoi. Pakiso eŋe kiruŋaŋo kibego rasu kakeiwane iwenka saket arikoi.
Yesu Kiruŋaŋo Kibego Rasukakoi
Eŋe numao ariu paki, ŋei mane Sairini matko ŋine, eŋetine Saimon maratkau paki, qebin kau Yesu wane kibeŋ qabeŋ tewetki arikoi.
Eŋe ari mage, kepe mane eŋetine Golgota, ea lotkekoi. Kepe eŋetine ea wane kine iwa yale, “Lewe Setne Kepe.”
Yewa rau pakiso, eŋe wain wisi tabaine teine earop mauluk maulukine ea manbi, ne detki paki, waulukke.
Pakiso, eŋe kiruŋaŋo kibeŋ qabego rasu kau paki, takot kine kineine ea wezu qe yuanbi paki, mapoke amanagukoi.
Ea wane ŋadino eŋe yewa eŋane diam metkoi.
Lewine kutno dere worik donene dapore det okanikeiwane, don iwa yale qekoi, “Iwa Yesu, Yuda ŋei eŋane Ŋei Waom.”
Pakiso eŋe borikine mama etke Yesurop weneŋ kibeŋ qabego kiruŋaŋo rasuotkoi, mane wonino, ŋo mane kanaino.
Ŋei ŋerep osino kere pore okan lewetene kaliŋ kito ruzake, Yesu mawa maket kitou paki rakoi,
“Ge Bakom Urum ra barakenom ketki, kaiwe karewe yewaoka koso maulukkenane rakone! Ge weleka Anutu Gipole gemaineo, yemo ge goŋomka qesiŋ nagunom! Kibeŋ qabego ŋine qoe ketnom!”
Numa weku yewaka pris ŋetne so ra rokop don kito ebo ebon so Yuda ŋei suaine, eŋe isibela qebela okanka rakoi,
“Eŋe ŋei ŋerep natne qesiŋonge, ŋo eŋine yemo mi qesiŋ nagumaike! Eŋe Israel eŋane Ŋei Waom me? Ea wane eŋe kibeŋ qabego ŋine baŋ qoe iwa kesiakeo, yemo ŋene baŋ eŋe detlukka malip kaikene!
Eŋe Anutu detlukka malipkaki paki, na Anutu wane Gipole ra okanmaike, ea yemo maine, ŋo Anutuŋo wetne eŋane pamaikeo, yemo ukude eŋe qesiŋkaki, ŋene kaŋem!”
Borikine mama Yesurop weneŋ kibeŋ qabego etkukoi, ere yalewaka mabaik qebaik okankakoi.
Yesu Seukke
Kepe oŋa bango 12 kilok, yewao kepe yewa korop goiŋ suaine kere panaman kito paki, sa 3 aua okange.
Naso 3 kilok okangi, Yesuŋo togoleka boka more rake, “Eli Eli lema sabaktani?” Don ea wane kine iwa yale, “Anutune, Anutune, ge onoka wane qeliŋ nanmaine?”
Ŋei natne yewa okorakoi, eŋe dere more, iwa yale rakoi, “Eŋe Elaiya wane bokamaike!”
Eŋano ŋine ŋei mane eŋe ikopka biririke ari more, wain dokune tabainerop eao lap lapŋo qe muruge more, kudupko piseki paki, Yesuŋo neakane mange.
Ŋo ŋei natne eŋe rakoi, “Ŋene tomaka more Elaiya eŋe qesiŋ kayakane sarimakeo, yemo kaŋem!”
Yesu eŋe koso manerop togogoleka bokakiso, yewaka asuine saket arike.
Pakiso, laplap suaine Bakom Urum koto mode ket okorake, ea keuoka puntuk wiri, weti kutno ŋine sariki, qela kino qoe, etke leleke. Kepe qiseki wesi suaine korop din bun wiri, yeo yeo arikoi.
Deŋesere poripke aŋaŋgi, so Anutu wane ŋei magu loutne koboboine ge more seukkoi, eŋane pareŋene ea ma wirikongi, wisikae wie warekoi.
Eŋe wie wareu, Yesu wisikae wieke ea wane ŋadino eŋe Mat Koboine Suaino Yerusalem ariu, yewa ŋei ŋerep loutneŋo marat onwarekoi.

Kawali ŋei eŋane ware wareene, so kawali ŋei eŋerop weneŋ geu paki Yesu warekakoi, eŋe memea make, ea so masi kine kine wakonge, ea kakoi, paki oŋaene qaeki rakoi, “Ŋei iwa eŋe welekatne Anutu wane Gipole!”
Ŋerep loutne eŋe yewa abaran okorau paki potpi ariki kakoi, eŋe Yesu ŋadino mogatka Galili ŋine sarikoi paki, eŋe qesiŋkakoi.
Eŋane keuo yemo Maria Magdalena, Maria mane Yakop so Yesep erane nagaetne, eŋe Zebedi gipoletkine erane nagaetne.
Yesu Pareŋine Kem Koto Motkoi.
Kepe ketki rarapko, ŋei mane aboŋine suaine, Arimatea mat welaine mane, eŋane eŋetine Yosep, eŋe yaleka Yesu wane medep geke.
Eŋe Pilat wane kaitko ari waketki paki, Yesu pareŋine ma ariakane qesonkake. Pakiso, Pilat eŋe Yesu wane pareŋine Yosep manikei wane ra ebonge.
Eso Yosep eŋe Yesu pareŋine ea maki paki, laplap musele maneŋo kawetkake.
Pakiso eŋine deŋesere biŋek mane kem koto muse musen wesi aŋaine koto yaso maulukke, eao motke. Motki paki wesi suaine rodiŋgi ari eaŋo deŋesereo wake waket aŋaine ea kito wonge metkiso, eŋe arike.
Maria Magdalena so Maria mane ere yewa deŋesere ka mogare metkoik.
Kawali Ŋei Eŋe Deŋesereo Diam Metkoi
Kepe qaeki kaiwe maneo eamo qezareko met met ea wane naso qoeke, pris ŋetne so Parisi eŋe korop Pilatrop lewaŋgoi.
Paki olale rakoi, “Suaine, ŋene detmaine, isi ŋei ea eŋe wisika geki paki, iwa yale rake, ‘Kaiwe karewe qoeki, ea wane ŋadino na baŋ wisikae wiekale.’

Yale rake, ea wane ge ra edannom, eŋe deŋesere ea diam seleleine ma warekau, kaiwe karewe ea qoeke, eso eŋine dokoine eŋe maine mi eweke more, ari pareŋine ea baŋ kobu makei, paki ŋei ŋerep maine mi edane raikei, ‘Eŋe mo seu seuo ŋine wisikae wiike.’ Iwa ŋadino isi eaŋo yemo zok qotkoine, alakan isi ea yuankayake.”
Rauso Pilatŋo edange, “Ŋine diam ŋei mane mau paki, ari deŋesere ea mauluke maine warekakei.”
Eso eŋe bira nagu ari, so wesi suaine ea ekiŋo sikatine qe makatakeu metki, so kawali ŋei natne biraonbi diam metkoi.
